name: product-knowledge
description: Product-management workflow skills for Hypefast PMs. Project/domain knowledge (e.g. Odoo) lives in the companion marketplace hypefast-arbi/projects.

plugins.name: pm-workflow
plugins.description: PM execution toolkit: create Confluence pages/PRDs, file Jira backlog tickets, write PRD success criteria, fill PRD requirement tables (Description of the User Flows), and build BPMN process diagrams.

plugins.name: qa-workflow
plugins.description: SDET/QA execution toolkit: author Given/When/Then test-case documents from acceptance criteria with full AC↔TC traceability, then create and update them as Confluence pages.
